I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from this incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka Sundaram posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that "Southgate dispatch" had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I also told him there's no street address for the site in the channel. There are no Tansley account files in the shared files either.
